# Code of Conduct

We want webmaster.rip to be a welcoming and constructive space for everyone.
Participants are expected to treat others with respect, communicate in good
faith, and focus criticism on ideas and work rather than people.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate and patient with people of different backgrounds and
  experience levels.
- Use inclusive language and accept constructive feedback.
- Respect privacy; do not publish personal information or private
  communications without consent.
- Keep discussions relevant and professional.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, deliberate intimidation, personal attacks,
and publishing private information without consent are not acceptable.

## Enforcement and reporting

Project maintainers may edit or remove content and may limit participation when
needed to protect the community. To report a conduct concern privately, contact
a repository maintainer through GitHub rather than posting sensitive details in
a public issue or pull request. Maintainers will review reports and take
appropriate action.

This code of conduct applies to project spaces, including issues, pull
requests, and project-related communications.
